navigateToReauth L138-144/web-resilience port: web saves window.location.href under RETURN_URL_KEY='teslasync-return-url' (preserved exact key) then redirects to the IdP with a window.location.reload() base-less fallback. Native-safe port: on the react-native-web target globalThis.location.reload exists, so the documented reload fallback is mirrored best-effort (sessionStorage.setItem of location.href guarded by try/catch for private-mode/quota, then loc.reload()); on true native there is no browser location, so queryClient.resetQueries({queryKey: sessionMonitorKey}) drops the cached /auth/session snapshot to force the auth gate to re-evaluate — the closest native analogue of 'send the user back to sign-in', documented here and in the file header.
